plugins.name: memento
plugins.description: A two-command micro-framework that gives Claude Code a memory across sessions: /session-start agrees the objective and plans the stages, /session-close verifies the results and distills them into a cumulative knowledge base under docs/ai/. Plus /project-brief to read where things stand and /memento:doctor to audit the record. Profiles adapt it to software or to data work. Any project, any language.
